title: Ford broadcasts 1965-1966 - 12237637
doc_notes: This document is a collection of radio broadcast scripts and statements by Congressman Gerald R. Ford from 1965-1966, including a specific call for a congressional UFO investigation.

incidents.summary: Representative Gerald R. Ford calls for a congressional investigation into a rash of reported UFO sightings in Southern Michigan and other parts of the country.
incidents.quote: I believe Congress should thoroughly investigate the rash of reported sightings of unidentified flying objects in Southern Michigan
